deviations: Standardization uses the mean and SD over the full database (5,775 municipalities) for every variable, including the 1921 fascist vote share regressions on the 5,358-municipality subsample, rather than re-standardizing within that subsample.

Cluster-robust F-statistic computed as the squared t-statistic of the instrument in the column (6) first stage with fixest's default small-sample adjustment (G/(G-1) and (N-1)/(N-K)); the paper's exact F-statistic convention is not stated.
notes: attempt-1 was exploratory (variable names, labels, missing counts; no RESULT lines). The final run is the first scored run and was not changed. Data: fascism_db.dta (5,775 rows, no missing values in the main variables). Specification: OLS first stage and 2SLS (fixest feols) with standardized dependent variable, endogenous socialist vote share 1919 (psu1919_vv) and instrument foots_pop6m. Controls: all 359 non-constant d_reg* regiment dummies, province1921 fixed effects, quartic in log 1911 population (lpop1911, lpop2-4) plus sh_pop_1911_be6; col (6) adds larea, centre_alt, max_alt; psu1913_vv; veterans74_95, veterans96_00, ard_vol_pop6m, army_suppliers_d, cruent_d; dlab, shcrop, landlord_ass; ind_workers, ind_firms, literacy, elites, bourgeoisie. SEs clustered by circondario1921. The 1921 sample is the rows with non-missing fascist1921_vv (imputed series). fascism_mod_elections_db.dta was not used.
